title: Input symbol at an interior position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For any natural number $i\leq |x|$, any controller state, any integer capture-head displacement, and any output word, the threaded-map configuration with input head at position $i+1$ reads the $i$-th bit of $x$, or no symbol if $i=|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
c is an M-configuration on x
i is a natural number at most the length of x
the capture-head displacement is an arbitrary integer
replaced:
In a threaded-map configuration whose input head has passed $i \le \abs{x}$
cells, the symbol read is the $i$-th bit of $x$ (the blank when
$i = \abs{x}$), independently of the preserved bank.
